articles.summary: Kinetik Holdings Inc. (NYSE: KNTK) (“ Kinetik ” or the “ Company ”) today announced the appointment of Craig Harris to the Kinetik Board of Directors, effective June 23, 2026. Craig Harris has more than 30 years of experience in the energy industry, with a background spanning engineering, operations, business development, and corporate strategy. From October 2022 to March 2026, Mr. Harris was a Senior Managing Director within Blackstone’s credit business. Prior to that, he held senior leadership roles at 3Bear Energy, Enable Midstream Partners, Columbia Midstream Group, and El Paso Corporation. articles.title: Kinetik Appoints New Board Member
